section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Drive Shaft
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Drive Shaft

content.description: Illustration showing the installation of inner race onto shaft using press and socket wrench, with matchmarks alignment indicated

items: Align the matchmarks and, using a press and socket wrench, install the inner race onto the shaft.
Using snap ring pliers, install the snap ring.

content.description: Hand holding and tapping balls into inner race with plastic hammer

items: Lightly tap in the balls with a plastic hammer.

content.text: Coat the inner race, the cage and balls with the grease supplied in the boot kit.

items: Align the matchmarks placed before assembly.

content.description: Installation of inboard joint onto drive shaft using press and socket wrench, showing alignment of matchmarks

items: Using a press and socket wrench, inboard joint onto drive shaft.
Using snap ring pliers, install new snap ring.

content.description: Cross-section diagram showing grease packing locations and seal packing around inboard joint flange

items: Pack 60g (0.13 lb) of grease into the flange side.

content.text: Use the grease supplied in the kit.

content.label: (e) Apply seal packing
content.description: around inboard side of the end plate.

items: Install it to the inboard joint.

content.text: Install the end plate by tapping around it.
Use the grease supplied in the boot kit.

content.description: Cross-section showing grease application points in outer race and boot of CV joint assembly

items: Apply grease into the outer race and boot.
